functions.description: Evaluate route-specific domestic, regional and customs requirements from exact legs and warehouse regulatory status. Local bonded stock is not exempt. Synthetic coverage only; no legal approval.

Evaluate current trusted policy and exact source-bound commodity, route, mandatory clauses, version and freshness. Only pass_sandbox may continue a simulated purchase; blocked or unknown stops execution. Never grants real import permission.
Verify exact source, task scope, current versions and recursive input freshness; return typed facts and missing requirements. This read grants no execution authority.
Read current commerce facts and stage-specific gaps. Missing buyer choices go to PA; merchant, stock, customs and fulfillment facts go to their source services.
Check original-order identity, account, freshness, evidence strength and test capture. Only an independent succeeded GET with exact captured charge establishes test_paid; not bank settlement.
Validate owned source receipts, exact original terms, freshness and independent provider read. PA requests and reports never establish payment or booking completion.
Validate a single observation's identity, source, relationships and freshness; return its facts and explicit unknowns. A known empty observation is partial evidence, never proof of complete absence.
Verify immutable source content, owned task relationships, and freshness; return only safe summary fields. Source connection authority is rechecked separately before each action and completion.
Narrow protocol readiness with a usable destination structure; this is not inventory, customs, purchase or delivery feasibility
Compare the independently read original order with fixed checkout items, cost breakdown, complete destination identity and budget; order confirmation is not fulfillment
Check query identity, freshness and bound source evidence; return display-price observations and unknowns without granting business authority

确认指定酒店、房型、入住退房日期、间数人数与条款；住宿完成是另一个明确终点

Evidence-backed freshness at the server clock; local refresh windows are not provider commitments
Ordered quantity minus accepted delivery allocations, with unit, specification and event checks
Actual arrival from accepted delivery events; an ETA is never an arrival
Provider confirmation plus required deposit evidence; paid alone is not confirmation
Match quote to request, selected route, parcel versions, weight and service
Compare a complete scoped total and price basis; a reservation deposit is not a total
Check effective confirmation for the exact venue, time, timezone and party size
Check the quoted product specification revision, quantity, capacity, complete total, destination and commitment
Check current evidenced slot eligibility for venue, time, timezone and party size
Evaluate a projected policy record at the current clock; real dispatch still requires the authoritative policy ledger.
